name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-skeeter
title: Redrawn Styled Skeeter
description:
Redrawn style graphics for the Skeeter custom sprite.
It includes alternate designs the enemy has had in other games, and also includes extra frames for dropping a bomb like they do in New Super Mario Bros.
Also should note that Bomb Skeeter and Modern Skeeter need file editing since they use pal F (pink palette).
